preprocess_images_with_annotations: preprocess a batch of images with COCO detection or panoptic annotations for DETR model input
post_process_object_detection: post-process DETR model outputs into final bounding boxes with scores and labels above a threshold
post_process_instance_segmentation: post-process DETR model outputs into instance segmentation masks with segment IDs and info
post_process_panoptic_segmentation: post-process DETR model outputs into panoptic segmentation with fused background labels
post_process_semantic_segmentation: post-process DETR model outputs into semantic segmentation class label maps
